acceptanceCriteria.text: One internal companion client owns all supported gh-makami invocation.
Explicit repository/PR identity is required and independent of unrelated cwd.
Current generation/head plus bounded normalized snapshot/delta/await results decode from the supported public contract.
Missing/incompatible/timeout/non-JSON/malformed results fail closed with stable bounded diagnostics.
No managed call path falls back to direct GitHub observation.
Hermetic/packed process tests cover successful observation, unchanged await/timeout, malformed result, missing companion, incompatible contract, and explicit identity mismatch.

issue.title: feat: integrate the gh-makami companion with explicit bounded PR observation
